Black Tides: The Curse of Blackbeard

Inherit the blood of the most feared pirate in history.

The Golden Age of Piracy is fading, but the legend of Blackbeard refuses to die. Edward Teach Jr has grown up carrying the weight of a father he never knew—the most notorious pirate captain to sail the Caribbean. When a long-buried map reveals that Blackbeard survived the battle history claims ended him, Edward seizes command of his ship for a monumental quest: a son’s journey to find his father, claim his legacy, and uncover a treasure powerful enough to reshape empires.

D-topia is AVAILABLE NOW on PlayStation 5.

Welcome to D-topia. As part of the Utopia Project, D-topia was created to maximize human happiness and comfort. Step into a future where happiness is curated by artificial intelligence in this gentle-paced puzzle adventure.

Tackle fun logic-based puzzles to resolve mechanical issues and keep the facilities running smoothly and meet the many vibrant residents, each with their own unique story and personal struggle.

But what happens when problems go beyond the mechanical? How will your choices impact the wellbeing of the residents, and the future of humanity? In a world of curated happiness, what does it mean to find purpose?

Play D-topia Today.

https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/helldivers-2/

Super Earth Intelligence reports confirm that the Automaton menace is constructing a devastating new Death Laser capable of threatening freedom across the galaxy. In response, Helldivers have been deployed to strike deep into enemy territory and dismantle this machine-engineered threat before it can be brought online.

Join us as we cover the latest developments from the Galactic War, the push against Automaton forces, and the ongoing fight to safeguard Super Earth from those who would see Managed Democracy extinguished.

Successful participants in this campaign will be rewarded with the KDM-500 Outrider Helmet, a symbol of courage for those willing to ride beyond the frontier in defense of liberty.
